hx_radial_distort_contour — 2D halcon_ext op

• Data kinds: contour → contour

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "hx_radial_distort_contour", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: change_radial_distortion_contours_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Apply radial distortion r' = r(1 + k r^2) to a contour (k from (a−0.5): barrel or pincushion).

Converts each contour point into coordinates d relative to the image centre (H/2, W/2) and, with the normalised radius r = |d| / (max(H, W)/2), returns the contour stretched as d' = d * (1 + k*r^2) (the 1st-order term of a radial distortion model).

• a → distortion coefficient k = (a - 0.5) * 1.5 (-0.75 to +0.75). k < 0 pulls points toward the centre (barrel), k > 0

spreads them outward (pincushion), no change at a=0.5.

• b is unused.

The radius is normalised by half of the image's long side, so at the image corners r is around 1, and with k = ±0.75 corner points move up to 1.75× / 0.25×. There is no inverse (flipping the sign of k does not restore it exactly). For trying the effect of lens distortion on contour measurements (hx_fit_circle_contour etc.), or for synthetic data augmentation.

Try it in Studio

The program below has been verified to run (same input as the figure). In Studio's help this block becomes buttons that load and run it on the spot.

threshold 0.50 0.50
sk_find_contours 0.50 0.50
hx_radial_distort_contour 0.50 0.50
